label: phase11-clock-reset-dependency-control-pi5
accepted_claims: The no-MMIO clock/reset dependency control archive constructed no forbidden RP1, clock/reset, GPIO, GIC, PCIe/MIP, DMA, or other MMIO addresses.
The Pi 5 selected and fetched the expected nonce-bearing control archive over TFTP.
The run-unique nonce token was absent before power and present after power.
The lab boot tree was restored to the pre-run baseline after capture.
rejected_claims: No RP1, clock/reset, GPIO, GIC, PCIe, DMA, hardware behavior, write path, event generation, interrupt delivery, Milestone 11.3, or phase transition is accepted from this no-MMIO control proof.
evidence_level: image/archive inspection, lab-controller API, serial hardware boot/output, stable TFTP delta, restore proof, replay checker
